_comment: 'stage' (French for internship) was removed from include: it collided with the common English word 'stage' (as in 'stage of the project'), causing false positives. 'stagiaire' already catches French internship postings.

internship.description: Internship / working-student style roles, language-agnostic across Europe

new-grad.description: Entry-level roles for recent graduates, language-agnostic across Europe and North America

junior.description: Junior-level roles -- the standard European-market title for entry-level, much more common there than the US-centric 'entry level'/'new grad' phrasing new-grad already covers.

techGate.description: Required for jobs from broad, all-industry job boards (adzuna/arbeitnow/remotive) so e.g. a nursing or retail internship doesn't pass just because its title says 'internship'. Curated ATS company postings (greenhouse/lever/ashby/workday) skip this gate -- config/companies.json is already a hand-picked tech company list.
